about: knowledge: recipes/swot-gauge-confrontation.md, the worked example for Baton Rouge 2024
text: Seen while exploring. The recipe's worked example scores all 50 pairs: change correlation +0.9567 and change RMSD 0.3823 m, which it reads as about four times the product's stated precision. Recomputed here identically (LOOK-013). With the three passes flagged reach_q 2 left out, the same scores are +0.9896 and 0.1859 m on 46 changes (LOOK-014). So most of the disagreement the worked example reports is three flagged passes, and the recipe has no step that says to apply the product's quality gate before scoring.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
